rule: Skill and agent git and gh commands reference captured identifiers only as quoted shell variables and paste only gate-validated placeholders
description: `plugin/skills/push-branch/SKILL.md` requirement 2 is the source for the push command form that applies the Shell Identifier Discipline in `plugin/governance/security-policy.md`: the skill's push is one call to `${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/skills/push-branch/scripts/push-branch.sh` whose only identifier arguments are the placeholders `<allowlist-validated-head>`, `<allowlist-validated-base>`, and `<allowlist-validated-remote>`, and the same span binds each placeholder to the input value that passed the input gate. The source pin is one span carrying that binding sentence and the invocation that uses it, so pasting a branch or remote literal into the invocation, replacing a placeholder with an unvalidated value, or deleting the binding to the input gate turns the suite red. The script reads the branch, commit, upstream, and push remote itself, in the same process as the push, and references them only as quoted shell variables. Ten consumers pin the same discipline at the other named command forms. In `plugin/skills/open-plan-pr/SKILL.md` step 6, one span carrying the sentence that binds each `<allowlist-validated-...>` placeholder to the input value that passed its gate, the conditions for passing `--remote` and `--expect-commit`, and the script invocation that passes `<allowlist-validated-head>`, `<allowlist-validated-base>`, `<allowlist-validated-remote>`, and `<allowlist-validated-commit>` to `${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/skills/open-plan-pr/scripts/open-plan-pr.sh`. That script runs every push, PR lookup, PR create, and PR read of the skill, and five pins in it carry those command forms, each referencing identifiers only as quoted shell variables: the open PR lookup `gh pr list --head "$head_name" --base "$base_name"`; the push span, which builds the push-branch argument array from `"$head_name"`, `"$base_name"`, `"$remote_name"`, and `"$expect_commit"` and runs `bash "$push_script" "${push_args[@]}"` as a child process; the create span, both branches of `gh pr create --base "$base_name" --title="$title_text" --body-file="$body_file"`, with and without `--draft`, neither passing `--head`; the verify span, from `gh pr view "$pr_number" --json headRefName,headRefOid,headRepository` through the shape check, the head branch blocker that compares against `"$head_name"`, the head SHA blocker that compares against `"$pushed_commit"`, the commit push-branch.sh reported, and the head repository blocker that compares against `"$push_repo_id"`, the id of the repository the push landed in; and the output span, whose two `printf` calls emit only captured variables. In `plugin/skills/molt/SKILL.md` requirement 5, one span carrying the sentence that binds `<allowlist-validated-trunk>` to the value that passed the input gate, together with the script invocation that passes it to `${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/skills/molt/scripts/molt.sh`. In `plugin/skills/create-working-branch/SKILL.md` requirement 3, one span carrying the sentence that binds each `<allowlist-validated-...>` placeholder to the value that passed the input gate or the checks in steps 1 and 2, together with the script invocation that passes `<allowlist-validated-base>`, `<allowlist-validated-working-branch>`, `<allowlist-validated-classification>`, `<allowlist-validated-trunk-freshness>`, and `<allowlist-validated-trunk>`. In `plugin/skills/gather-facts/SKILL.md` requirement 1, one span carrying the sentence that binds each `<allowlist-validated-...>` placeholder to an input value that passed the input gate, the conditions for passing `--remote` and `--ref`, and the script invocation that passes `<allowlist-validated-trunk>`, `<allowlist-validated-remote>`, and `<allowlist-validated-reference>`. In `plugin/agents/github-reviewer.md` step 7, the single push, one span carrying the script invocation with the `<allowlist-validated-working_branch>` and `<allowlist-validated-base>` placeholders and the fixed `origin` remote, and the rule that exit 1 returns `blocked`. Replacing any captured variable with a pasted literal, or a gate-validated placeholder with a raw value, turns the suite red. What these pins honestly guarantee is exactly that these eleven word sequences exist in these seven named files; they claim nothing about meaning and nothing about what an agent actually runs. Residuals, stated plainly: (1) a meaning inversion around the pinned bytes, such as surrounding prose that offers a pasted-literal alternative to a pinned command, is invisible; (2) the pins cover only the named forms: any other command in these files, or a new command added beside a pinned one, that pastes an identifier stays green; the push-branch script's own git commands are not pinned here (its upstream comparison, mode selection, and own-name refspec are pinned by the working-branch no-track fixture, and its behavior is asserted by `tools/test_push_branch.sh`), and the create-working-branch and gather-facts scripts' own git and gh commands are not pinned here (the create-working-branch script's no-track creation and upstream rule are pinned by the working-branch no-track fixture, and the two scripts' behavior is asserted by `tools/test_create_working_branch.sh` and `tools/test_gather_facts.sh`); the molt script's own git commands are not pinned here (its trunk refusal is pinned by the no-trunk-commit fixture, and its behavior is asserted by `tools/test_molt.sh`); the open-plan-pr script lines outside the five pinned spans are not pinned here (its gates on the head, base, remote, PR URL, PR number, and commits are pinned by the shell identifier discipline fixture, its push-branch.sh target by the working-branch no-track fixture, and its behavior is asserted by `tools/test_open_plan_pr.sh`); (3) a NEW skill or agent that authors git or gh commands with pasted identifiers is an absence defect that no fixture in this directory can see, per rule 7 of the pin-authoring contract, and no structural check for it exists in `tools/policy_check.sh`; (4) the pins prove the documented form exists, not that the executing agent runs it rather than a pasted variant; (5) the github-reviewer step 7 placeholders are tied to the gated inputs only by their names and by the github-reviewer input gate sentence pinned in the shell identifier discipline fixture, because the pinned span carries no sentence that binds them; likewise the open-plan-pr script's quoted variables are tied to its own gates only by their names, and those gates are pinned by the shell identifier discipline fixture; (6) the github-reviewer grant wording in `plugin/governance/safety-rails.md` is outside these pins.

source.pattern: Run the push script, where each `<allowlist-validated-...>` placeholder is the input value that passed the input gate. Pass `--remote` only when `push_remote` is provided: ```bash bash "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/skills/push-branch/scripts/push-branch.sh" --head <allowlist-validated-head> --base <allowlist-validated-base> [--remote <allowlist-validated-remote>] --on-reject block --no-upstream block

consumers.pattern: Run the PR script, where each `<allowlist-validated-...>` placeholder is the input value that passed its gate above and `<token>` is the token from step 5. Pass `--remote` only when `push_remote` is provided, and `--expect-commit` only when `expect_commit` is provided: ```bash bash "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/skills/open-plan-pr/scripts/open-plan-pr.sh" --head <allowlist-validated-head> --base <allowlist-validated-base> [--remote <allowlist-validated-remote>] [--expect-commit <allowlist-validated-commit>] --inputs .hivemind/pr-inputs-<token>.json

push_args=(--head "$head_name" --base "$base_name" --report-remote yes) if [ "$remote_seen" = true ]; then push_args+=(--remote "$remote_name") fi push_args+=(--on-reject warn --no-upstream origin) if [ "$expect_commit_seen" = true ]; then push_args+=(--expect-commit "$expect_commit") fi push_rc=0 push_output="$(bash "$push_script" "${push_args[@]}" 2>"$push_err_file")" || push_rc=$?

if [ "$draft_value" = true ]; then create_output="$(gh pr create --base "$base_name" --title="$title_text" --body-file="$body_file" --draft </dev/null 2>"$create_err_file")" || create_rc=$? else create_output="$(gh pr create --base "$base_name" --title="$title_text" --body-file="$body_file" </dev/null 2>"$create_err_file")" || create_rc=$? fi

gh pr view "$pr_number" --json headRefName,headRefOid,headRepository </dev/null >"$view_file" 2>/dev/null \ || blocker "could not read the PR head branch or head SHA" view_shape="$(jq -r 'if type == "object" and (.headRefName | type) == "string" and (.headRefOid | type) == "string" and (.headRepository == null or ((.headRepository | type) == "object" and (.headRepository.id | type) == "string")) then "ok" else "bad" end' "$view_file" 2>/dev/null)" \ || blocker "could not read the PR head branch or head SHA" [ "$view_shape" = ok ] || blocker "could not read the PR head branch or head SHA" head_match="$(jq -r --arg head "$head_name" '.headRefName == $head' "$view_file" 2>/dev/null)" \ || blocker "could not read the PR head branch or head SHA" [ "$head_match" = true ] || blocker "PR head branch does not match head" oid_match="$(jq -r --arg commit "$pushed_commit" '.headRefOid == $commit' "$view_file" 2>/dev/null)" \ || blocker "could not read the PR head branch or head SHA" [ "$oid_match" = true ] || blocker "PR head SHA does not match the pushed commit" if [ -n "$push_repo_id" ]; then repo_match="$(jq -r --arg repo "$push_repo_id" '.headRepository != null and .headRepository.id == $repo' "$view_file" 2>/dev/null)" \ || blocker "could not read the PR head branch or head SHA" [ "$repo_match" = true ] || blocker "PR head repository does not match the push remote"

if [ -n "$push_warning" ]; then printf 'url: %s
head_ref_oid: %s
created: %s
warning: %s
' "$pr_url" "$pushed_commit" "$created_value" "$push_warning" else printf 'url: %s
head_ref_oid: %s
created: %s
' "$pr_url" "$pushed_commit" "$created_value" fi

Run the commit script, where `<allowlist-validated-trunk>` is the value that passed the input gate and `<token>` is the token from requirement 4: ```bash bash "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/skills/molt/scripts/molt.sh" --trunk <allowlist-validated-trunk> --inputs .hivemind/molt-inputs-<token>.json

Run the branch script, where each `<allowlist-validated-...>` placeholder is the value that passed the input gate or the checks in steps 1 and 2: ```bash bash "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/skills/create-working-branch/scripts/create-working-branch.sh" --base <allowlist-validated-base> --branch <allowlist-validated-working-branch> --classification <allowlist-validated-classification> --trunk-freshness <allowlist-validated-trunk-freshness> --trunk <allowlist-validated-trunk>

Run the facts script, where each `<allowlist-validated-...>` placeholder is an input value that passed the input gate. Pass `--remote` only when `remote` is provided, and one `--ref` per reference: ```bash bash "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/skills/gather-facts/scripts/gather-facts.sh" --trunk <allowlist-validated-trunk> [--remote <allowlist-validated-remote>] [--ref <allowlist-validated-reference>]...

push ONCE (batch only, never per fix) via `bash "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/skills/push-branch/scripts/push-branch.sh" --head <allowlist-validated-working_branch> --base <allowlist-validated-base> --remote origin`; exit 1 means return `blocked` (relay the blocker).
